task: Perform an exhaustive read-only audit of current ED-Finder main for the end-state authority: every active/current Python execution surface must target CPython 3.14, the V3 API PostgreSQL driver remains asyncpg, and all active synchronous PostgreSQL code should use Psycopg 3 rather than psycopg2. Do not modify files, commit, push, deploy, access production, or use production credentials. Classify every literal Python 3.12/3.11 occurrence into active executable/configuration/current-authority documentation versus historical evidence/false positive, and list every active file that must change. Audit workflows, Dockerfiles, pyproject/requirements, Windows/dev bootstrap, OpenAPI generation, maintenance/ops, importer, scripts/checks/repair/release, shared_contracts, tests/test doubles and dependency packaging. Separately classify every psycopg2/psycopg2-binary/py3-psycopg2 reference into active executable/dependency/test authority versus historical text, and identify exact Psycopg 3 compatibility changes needed (row factories, SQL composition, cursor APIs, exception names, bulk helpers, COPY/execute_values equivalents, transaction/autocommit semantics). Explicitly protect apps/api asyncpg ownership. Produce a concrete, bounded migration sequence and regression guards that can prove: no active Python <3.14 selection; no active psycopg2 dependency/import/package; API remains asyncpg; synchronous PostgreSQL paths use psycopg. Note any blockers to CPython 3.14/Psycopg 3 compatibility. This is investigation only.
